note: Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are original, written for this entry, with the source of each fact named beside it.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies first; this one unlocks on its own the moment the last one lands. Clear the one missable trophy early, then work the roadmap from top to bottom so nothing is left to the end.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. A story trophy: it unlocks through normal story progress and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. A story trophy that comes with normal progress; nothing special to do and nothing to miss.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. A story trophy, unmissable. The name is shown exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. A story trophy that unlocks through normal progress.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. A story trophy, unmissable, earned by playing the story through.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Listings differ on whether this is Chapter 5 or simply the final mission; the mission itself is the same one, and the trophy is unmissable either way.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story trophy that unlocks by playing the mission to its end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story trophy that comes with normal story progress.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story trophy that unlocks by playing the mission through.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story trophy that comes with normal story progress.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: every story mission, stranger strand, collectible set and activity this checklist tracks. This is the last trophy most players earn. Follow the roadmap tab in order so the grind is spread out instead of piled up at the end.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts anywhere in free roam: jumps, near misses and airtime all count. Keep going to 300 stunts, because the 100% completion checklist asks for 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, bowling, arcade games, drone racing, the shooting range and the rest. One try of each is enough; you do not need to win or finish any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold each challenge as you unlock new ranges, and replay the ones you missed: replays cost nothing but time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Fly a practice run first to learn each course's line, then race to win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida: street, off-road and water events all count toward the 20. Vary the event type, because winning the same race twice does not count twice.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Watch the line tension while you reel: steady pressure wins, yanking snaps the line.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game: play any cabinet through to its end. Pick a short game for a quick unlock.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. A stranger-chain trophy: keep Andy's missions going whenever they appear, because stranger chains can close as the story moves on.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. A stranger-chain trophy: work Kenton's missions as they appear rather than leaving the whole chain for after the story.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. A stranger-chain trophy: keep Billy's missions moving when they show up.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore; finish whole strands, not single missions. Some strands only open during certain story chapters, so start them when they appear.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. A stranger-chain trophy: keep Randy's missions going as they appear.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. A stranger-chain trophy: work Tyrone's missions when they appear.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. This is the only trophy the guides flag as possibly missable: the spots are tied to Chapter 1, so meditate at each spot the moment you find it and never leave them for after the story. If a spot stops being available, the trophy may be locked for this playthrough.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Track it through the wilds of Leonida and take it down cleanly.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; sweep each area fully before moving on, and use the collectibles filter here to track which sets are done.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK spots are spread across the whole map, so work area by area and clear every spot in one district before moving to the next.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover stunts, combat, driving and more, and progress adds up across all of them, so this one finishes itself while you chase the others.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level together, then break line of sight and hide until it clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three robberies in one run and keep the heat off until the third shop is done.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicles register as you drive or encounter them, so vary the cars you take and steal the ones you have not seen before.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies first, trigger Combat Focus, and clear five before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a passenger plane and fly away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County; entering the tank unlocks the trophy. Expect heavy resistance on the way in and out.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the guards, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Plan the exit before you go in: the escape counts as much as the robbery, and a failed getaway wastes the whole job.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit the truck, grab the cash, and lose the heat before it builds.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, so drive every road and visit every named area; the last few are the small ones off the main routes.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang; tick them off as you find them across the map.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the bar spot on Ocean Beach, order the cocktail, and take in the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through the showroom glass and out onto the street.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, take the luxury watch, the unique shotgun and the safe contents, then escape the police.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both protagonists. Train and build both characters up together; the trophy lands when the pair hits the top.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. PlayStation tracks this one to a count of 500, and it accumulates across the whole playthrough as you keep making story and side choices.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: fail an attempt, then succeed on the retry. The description points at a second try working where the first did not.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange in Leonida. Keep an eye out for odd events while exploring; the strange ones find you if you wander.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder bills as you earn them; the total accumulates across the whole playthrough.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Big purchases count fastest: vehicles and properties push the total up quicker than small buys.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy them as you can afford them; the last one is the most expensive, so save for it.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find fresh vehicles around Leonida, bring them to the app, and register each one.
